title: UC, Categorically: Rigorous Diagrammatic Proofs
summary: Category theory is a mathematical theory of composition, widely used in logic, computing, and physics. Here we apply it to give a theory of secure composition. In particular, we provide a categorical treatment of Canetti's Universal Composability (UC) framework for systems with a static number of parties and sessions, often termed UC for static systems, yielding four benefits. First, we present our results graphically yet retain rigor by applying a standard categorical technique known as string diagrams. In particular, our formulation of the composition theorem can be graphically verified…
